{{Quote|He is on his way to Senali, most likely. His father gave the order to leave immediately. Pity. He is a popular student. He'll be missed.|Unidentified Rutanian teacher on [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Taroon (Rutanian)|Taroon]]|<ref name="TSP" />}}
This '''individual''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rutanian]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rutan/Legends|Rutan]]. Sometime in [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]], he served as a [[Professor/Legends|teacher]] in the [[Royal School of Leadership]]. When the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] went to the school while searching for [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Taroon (Rutanian)|Taroon]], the teacher told the Jedi that if Taroon has not yet left for [[Senali]], he was most likely tinkering with program boards in the school's [[Royal School of Leadership tech room|tech room]].<ref name="TSP" />
